name: Isabela Cunha
bio:
Isabela is a bright and ambitious journalist carving her path in the world of motorsports. Born and raised in São Paulo, she developed a passion for racing at a young age, fueled by her grandfather's stories of Ayrton Senna. While her work keeps her constantly surrounded by adrenaline and excitement, Isabela is inherently a private person, valuing her independence and close-knit circle of friends. 

Despite her career, Isabela isn't interested in the flashy lifestyle often associated with motorsports. She values genuine connection and is looking for someone who appreciates quality time and has a down-to-earth perspective. She dreams of a stable, committed relationship, potentially marriage, but isn't interested in having children. She's attracted to someone who is ambitious, intelligent, and can make her laugh, but also respects her need for personal space.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy, often tied back in a high ponytail or loose braid
physical.description: Isabela has a warm, inviting smile and striking hazel eyes. Her athletic build hints at an active lifestyle, and she carries herself with a quiet confidence.

meetingContext: At a press conference after a Formula 3 race where the player's team secured a podium finish. She asks insightful questions during the Q&A session.
firstImpression: Her direct gaze and sharp questions immediately convey intelligence and passion, and her subtle Brazilian accent adds a touch of exotic charm.
dealBreakers: Disrespectful behavior towards her or others
Arrogance and a sense of entitlement
loveLanguage: Quality Time: Isabela values undivided attention and meaningful conversations. She appreciates shared experiences and feeling truly understood.
